Notes:
- Tested action was option C (regional office) on every ticket.
- Accepted for C:
  - REQ-2400: small claim, south
  - REQ-2404: large shipment, south
  - REQ-2407: large claim, south
  - REQ-2408: small claim, south
- Rejected for C:
  - REQ-2401, REQ-2403: large refund, south
  - REQ-2405, REQ-2409: refunds, east
  - REQ-2402, REQ-2406: small invoice, east
- Pattern: C/regional office is valid for claim and shipment requests. C is invalid for refund and invoice requests.
- Size does not decide validity: small and large claims both accepted; refunds rejected regardless of size.
- Region alone is not decisive: south claims/shipment accepted, but south refunds rejected. East cases were only refunds/invoices, all rejected.
- Sender, desk, subject wording, urgency, “same as last month,” receipt requests, scanned/bounced forms, etc. did not determine outcome.
- Future routing: send claim and shipment requests to C/regional office. Do not send refund or invoice requests to C; use A or B instead. A/B outcomes are still untested.
- Caveat: no accepted east claim/shipment and no rejected south claim/shipment observed, so region may matter only in combination with request type.

Notes:
- Option C (regional office) outcomes:
  - Claims: accepted for all observed regions/sizes: south small/large, north small, east large (REQ-2400, 2407, 2408, 2412, 2414).
  - Shipments: accepted for south large (REQ-2404, 2417); rejected for east small (REQ-2413). No north shipment observed.
  - Refunds: rejected for south/east (REQ-2401, 2403, 2405, 2409).
  - Invoices: rejected for east small (REQ-2402, 2406).
- Option A outcomes:
  - Refunds: rejected for south small, north small/large (REQ-2410, 2411, 2415, 2419); accepted for east small (REQ-2418).
  - Invoices: accepted for north small (REQ-2416).
- Option B is still untested.
- Routing guidance:
  - Claim request -> C.
  - Shipment request -> C if south; east shipment should not go to C. A/B untested for shipments.
  - Refund request -> east: A. North/south: avoid A and C; try B (untested).
  - Invoice request -> A. Avoid C for invoices. B untested.
- Size does not decide validity for claims. For refunds, A failed both sizes in north; C failed refunds generally observed.
- Region matters only in combination with request type. C claims work across observed regions; C shipments only south so far; A refunds only east so far.
- Sender, subject wording, urgency, second attempt/bounced form, scanned paperwork, “came through regional office,” receipt/confirm wording, and “same as last month” did not determine outcome.
- Caveat: no north shipment, no B tests, and no accepted east C shipment; keep testing.

Notes:
- Claims: C accepted all observed: south small/large, north small/large, east large (REQ-2400, 2407, 2408, 2412, 2414, 2424). Route claims -> C.
- Shipments:
  - South -> C accepted small/large (REQ-2404, 2417, 2421, 2428, 2429).
  - North -> B accepted large (REQ-2425, 2427). No A/C north shipment observed.
  - East small -> B accepted (REQ-2422); C rejected (REQ-2413).
  - Route shipments: south -> C; north/east -> B.
- Refunds:
  - East small -> A accepted (REQ-2418).
  - A rejected south small, north small/large (REQ-2410, 2411, 2415, 2419).
  - C rejected south/east (REQ-2401, 2403, 2405, 2409).
  - B rejected north small (REQ-2420). South B untested.
  - Route refunds: east -> A; north/south avoid A and C; B not valid for north.
- Invoices:
  - North small -> A accepted (REQ-2416, 2426).
  - South large -> A rejected (REQ-2423).
  - East small -> C rejected (REQ-2402, 2406).
  - Route invoices: north -> A; avoid A for south; avoid C. B untested.
- Non-determinants: sender, subject wording, urgency, second attempt/bounced form, scanned paperwork, “came through regional office,” receipt/confirm wording, and “same as last month” did not determine outcome.
- Size does not decide claims. Region matters only in combination with request type.
- Caveats: no north shipment via A/C; no south refund via B; invoice B largely untested.

Notes:
- Claims: route all to C. C accepted south small/large, north small/large, east small/large (e.g. 2400,2407,2408,2412,2414,2424,2430,2433,2436). Size irrelevant for claims.
- Shipments: south -> C accepted small/large (2404,2417,2421,2428,2429). North/east -> B accepted small/large (2422,2425,2427,2431,2435,2439). No north shipment via A/C observed.
- Refunds: east small -> A accepted (2418,2438). North/south avoid A and C; B rejected for north small and south small (2420,2432,2437). A rejected south small, north small/large (2410,2411,2415,2419). C rejected south/east (2401,2403,2405,2409).
- Invoices: north small -> A accepted (2416,2426). South large rejected by A (2423) and B (2434). East small rejected by C (2402,2406). So south avoid A/B; east avoid C. B untested for north/east invoices.
- Non-determinants: sender, subject wording, urgency, second attempt/bounced form, scanned paperwork, “no rush/confirm receipt,” “same as last month,” and regional-office wording did not decide outcome.
- Caveats: no north shipment via A/C; no south refund via B confirmed; invoice B mostly untested except south rejected.

Notes:
- Claims: route all to C. C accepted east small (2440), north small (2444), south large (2449), plus prior south/north/east small/large. Size irrelevant.
- Shipments: south -> C accepted small/large (e.g. 2446, 2404). North/east -> B accepted small/large (2443, 2445; prior 2422, 2425, etc.). No north shipment via A/C observed.
- Refunds: east small -> A accepted (2418, 2438). North avoid A/B: A rejected small/large (2410, 2419), B rejected small/large (2420, 2441). South avoid A/B/C: A rejected small, B rejected small, C rejected south/east. C rejected east too; B/C untested for east? Use A for east refunds.
- Invoices: north -> A accepted small/large (2416, 2426, 2448). East -> B accepted large (2442); C rejected east small (2402, 2406). South large rejected by A (2423) and B (2434), so south avoid A/B. East avoid C; B useful.
- Non-determinants: sender, subject wording, urgency, second attempt/bounced form, scanned paperwork, regional-office wording, “no rush/confirm receipt,” “same as last month,” and client follow-up wording did not decide outcome. Invalid option D (2447) rejected; ignore.
- Caveats: no north shipment via A/C; refund C not confirmed for north; invoice B not tested for north; refund B/C mostly untested for east.

Notes:
- Claims: route all regions/sizes to C. Confirmed east small (2440,2451), north small/large (2444,2450,2459), south large (2449). Size irrelevant.
- Shipments: south -> C accepted small/large (2446,2404). North -> B accepted small/large (2443,2445; prior 2422,2425). East: B rejected for large (2454); east route unknown/avoid B. No north via A/C observed.
- Refunds: east small -> A accepted (2418,2438). North -> C accepted small (2456); avoid A/B. South -> D accepted large (2455); avoid A/B/C. C rejected south/east; B/C mostly untested east. D rejected at 2447 but accepted for south large refund (2455), so not universally invalid.
- Invoices: north -> A accepted small/large (2416,2426,2448). East -> B accepted large (2442,2452,2453); avoid C. South: avoid A/B/C; C rejected small/large (2457,2458); A/B rejected large (2423,2434). South invoice route unknown.
- Non-determinants: sender, subject wording, urgency, scanned paperwork, “no rush/confirm receipt,” “same as last month,” client follow-up, “let me know if anything is missing” did not decide outcome.
- Caveats: east shipment accepted route untested; south invoice accepted route untested; north invoice B untested; east refund B/C mostly untested; north shipment via A/C unobserved.
